failure.sectionTitle: Arbitrary limits, infinity, and maximal power
failure.message: Four distinct locked con moves cannot each appear exactly once with their own score in only three exchange rows.

rejectedAlternatives: Omitting a locked move would make the publication incomplete.
Combining two moves into one card would erase a distinct ledger move and its locked score.
Changing the frozen inventory or rerunning the single score pass would violate the evidence and score locks.

boundedRecovery.description: Permit exactly four exchange rows for Debate 196 section s3 while retaining the ordinary three-row maximum everywhere else.
